messages:
elena: Quick ask for runtime — were finalizing a launch blog + webinar. Need a compact benchmark bundle we can cite (CSV + one PNG).

Specifically: heatmap showing coldstart vs steady for seqlen buckets, 50/95/99 per-request latencies, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens for fp16 and quantized-int8. Keep the run reproducible with an env.txt and exact command.

matt: Understood. Which model + matrix? batch/concurrency?

elena: redwood/3b-compat-v1 (prod-like). Matrix: batch=1,8 ; conc=1,16 ; seqlens=32,192,1024. Percentiles per-request. Warmup note required.

sophie: Marketing will use one heatmap (coldstart x seqlen) and a small two-column chart (throughput vs $/1k). Also include raw token counts and billing units so we can compute $$. If quantized runs have instability at long contexts call it out. :pray: 

andy: Plan: 2 warmups, 120 samples per cell, capture 50/95/99, GPU util, kernel warnings to stderr. We'll produce CSV, PNG, env.txt, and a short README with reproduce steps. Targeting a smoke run tomorrow morning.

elena: Sample payloads: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use "webinar-clean" prompts).

matt: Ill capture commit, CUDA, driver, and kernel selection. We should also include 95% CI where possible.

andy: Minimal reproduce snippet well attach:

```
# reproduce-smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'

# note: run with RUNTIME_ENV=quant=int8 OR fp16, set CONCURRENCY env for steady-state
```

runtime-bot: Job created: run_id=mb-2026-2834-01, logs: /internal/bench/runs/mb-2026-2834-01. ETA ~3h.

matt: If int8 is flaky at 1024, capture stderr + the exact kernel/version and mark the cell as unstable. We'll provide a conservative suggested claim for marketing.

sophie: Deadline: need artifact bundle (CSV + normalized chart + PNG + brief caveats) by Thu 18:00 PT. Call it out now if you need more time.

andy: Acknowledged. Aim for Wed EOD run, Thu morning artifacts. Will ping on completion and attach artifacts link.

elena: Thanks — please ping @matt @andy on updates. Keep the slide focused.
